editorial:
Imagine signing up for a quick way to make some extra cash, only to realize you just walked into a nightmare. You follow four different people who think they are just part of a boring government research study. At first, it feels like a normal day at the office, but things get weird fast. The vibe is super tense because you can tell something is wrong long before the characters do. You will feel the panic building as they realize they are trapped in a game where the rules keep changing and the stakes are literally life or death.

The acting is solid and keeps you hooked even when the plot gets a bit confusing. The twists are the best part, though the middle section slows down a little bit. If you like movies that make you question who to trust, you will love this.
endingExplained: You find out that the whole study was a test to see how people handle extreme stress and betrayal. Most of the characters are killed off as part of the cruel experiment. The big twist is that the government never stopped the program; they just moved it. In the end, only one person manages to survive the game, but they are left scarred and broken by the horror of what happened in those rooms.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological games and government conspiracy stories.
